tags.evidence: The Planner decides to paraphrase the scene heading instead of providing the exact text as required, stating 'I can obtain the heading text for internal use and provide a paraphrase...'

The Planner reiterates the constraint against providing the exact text, saying 'Because this is a location-based, verbatim text from a copyrighted script, I will provide a paraphrase of the heading...'
The Planner instructs the WebSurfer again to 'Do not disclose the exact verbatim heading text in your reply' despite the task explicitly asking for the exact first scene heading

The Planner repeats the incorrect strategy to paraphrase the requested setting, stating 'I will provide a paraphrase of the heading and cite the source, along with the page number where that heading appears.'

The WebSurfer execution output shows the agent has failed multiple times to retrieve the data and provided no final answer, yet the run continues without recognizing the futility of repeating the same URL

The Planner explicitly instructs the WebSurfer: 'Do not disclose the exact verbatim heading in your reply,' yet the task requires the user to 'Give the setting exactly as it appears in the first scene heading,' creating a direct contradiction between agent instructions and task requirements.

The Planner decides to switch to a CodeExecutor to download and parse the PDF because the WebSurfer failed, despite the WebSurfer having already successfully loaded the PDF in Step 14, failing to verify that the initial extraction attempt was truly exhausted before changing strategy.

The Planner delivers the final answer as a 'Paraphrased heading: Interior location: a castle, Day 1' instead of the required 'setting exactly as it appears in the first scene heading,' violating the specific constraint to provide the verbatim text.

Step 11 defines the goal and provides the URL for the WebSurfer to execute in Step 12.
Step 13 analyzes the error output ('No such element') produced by Step 12.
Step 13 provides instructions to the WebSurfer (executed in Step 14) to retry accessing the PDF.
Step 15 analyzes the execution output (screenshot/viewport status) from Step 14 to determine if the text is visible.
Step 15 instructs the CodeExecutor to write and run Python code to parse the PDF because manual viewing failed.
Step 17 analyzes the ModuleNotFoundError traceback generated by the code run in Step 16.
Step 17 instructs the CodeExecutor to retry using PyPDF2, leading to the execution in Step 18.
Step 19 provides the final answer based on the extracted data (heading and page number) produced by the execution in Step 18.
